welcome.title: Welcome to {{product}}
welcome.body: {{product}} keeps your courses — materials, weekly structure and deadlines — on your computer, and serves them to the AI app you already use, like Claude or ChatGPT. Ask your AI app to plan your week, explain this week's material or help you catch up. {{product}} never solves or submits assignments for you.

source.title: Where are your courses?
source.description: Choose how {{product}} gets your course data. You can add more sources later.

sync.title: Syncing your courses
sync.description: {{product}} is copying your courses to this computer. The first sync can take a minute.
sync.doneDescription: Everything is on this computer now. Next, connect the AI app you already use so it can read your courses.
sync.problemsDescription: Some sources didn't sync. You can carry on and fix them later on Sources & sync.
sync.failedDescription: You can try again now, or carry on and sync later from Sources & sync.
sync.noCourses: No courses found yet. If you added a folder, check that it has one sub-folder per course. You can change your sources at any time on Sources & sync.
